# Strike design

> Strike's brand and design rules for AI tools: the core rules, the detailed rules, design tokens, logo files and fonts, packaged for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, AGENTS.md tools, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, Perplexity and Figma.

Strike is the options exchange that never closes. To make anything for Strike, read STRIKE-DESIGN.md and follow it. core.md is the short version (5,591 characters). All links here are relative to this file.

## Start here
- [STRIKE-DESIGN.md](STRIKE-DESIGN.md): every rule, the facts you may use and the token values, in one file
- [core.md](core.md): the core rules only
- [manifest.json](manifest.json): the targets, downloads, logos, colours and fonts, as JSON

## Claude
- [claude/README.md](claude/README.md): How to install the Claude files
- [claude/strike-design/SKILL.md](claude/strike-design/SKILL.md): The Claude skill: core rules and the list of its files
- [claude/strike-design/assets/README.md](claude/strike-design/assets/README.md): How to install the Claude files
- [claude/strike-design/assets/fonts/fonts.css](claude/strike-design/assets/fonts/fonts.css): @font-face rules for the brand fonts
- [claude/strike-design/references/checklist.md](claude/strike-design/references/checklist.md): The checks to run before handing work over.
- [claude/strike-design/references/colour.md](claude/strike-design/references/colour.md): Palette with hex values, light mode, how much green, gradients, profit and loss, measured contrast pairs. Read before choosing or checking any colour.
- [claude/strike-design/references/data.md](claude/strike-design/references/data.md): Charts and infographics: number first, chart types, colours, labels, axes, sources. Read for any chart or data graphic.
- [claude/strike-design/references/formats.md](claude/strike-design/references/formats.md): Sizes and layouts for X posts and threads, posters, slides, documents and email. Read when making one of these.
- [claude/strike-design/references/illustration-motion.md](claude/strike-design/references/illustration-motion.md): Line illustration rules (isometric or flat, line greys, dashes, labels) and motion timing. Read for illustrations and animation.
- [claude/strike-design/references/layout-ui.md](claude/strike-design/references/layout-ui.md): Grid, margins, spacing, surfaces and component specs (buttons, inputs, cards, tables, modals, states, icons). Read for any UI or layout.
- [claude/strike-design/references/logo.md](claude/strike-design/references/logo.md): Which logo file for which ground, minimum sizes, clear space, misuse, and sub-brand lockups. Read whenever the logo appears.
- [claude/strike-design/references/tailwind.preset.cjs](claude/strike-design/references/tailwind.preset.cjs): Tailwind v3 preset
- [claude/strike-design/references/theme.css](claude/strike-design/references/theme.css): Tailwind v4 theme
- [claude/strike-design/references/tokens.css](claude/strike-design/references/tokens.css): CSS variables, dark by default and light under [data-theme="light"], with type classes
- [claude/strike-design/references/tokens.json](claude/strike-design/references/tokens.json): Design tokens in W3C Design Tokens format
- [claude/strike-design/references/type.md](claude/strike-design/references/type.md): Fonts, heading rules, the type scale, numbers and line length. Read before setting any text.
- [claude/strike-design/references/words.md](claude/strike-design/references/words.md): Copy rules, the facts you may use, custody wording, the risk line and legal limits. Read for any headline, copy or claim.
- [claude/strike-design/scripts/check.mjs](claude/strike-design/scripts/check.mjs): Brand checker: node check.mjs <files>
- [claude/strike-design/scripts/lockup.mjs](claude/strike-design/scripts/lockup.mjs): Sub-brand lockup generator
- [claude/strike-design.zip](claude/strike-design.zip): Everything for Claude, zipped
